components.css: .ds-family{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;font:13px system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#edf1f8)}.ds-family-screen{min-width:0;padding:16px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface,#172237)}.ds-family-screen h3{font-size:18px}.ds-family-screen header{font-size:20px;margin:0 0 16px}.ds-family-screen article{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;margin:12px 0}.ds-family-screen small,.ds-family-screen p{color:var(--muted,#a9b8cd)}.ds-family-build{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}.ds-family-stat{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin:8px 0}.ds-family-screen select,.ds-family-screen input{min-width:0;max-width:100%;height:44px;border:1px solid var(--border,#35445b);border-radius:8px;padding:0 8px;background:var(--canvas,#0d1424);color:var(--ink,#edf1f8)}.ds-family-screen button{border:0;border-radius:8px;background:var(--primary,#e0c48b);color:var(--canvas,#0d1424);padding:8px;cursor:pointer}.ds-family-screen button:hover{filter:brightness(1.1)}.ds-family-screen button:focus-visible,.ds-family-screen input:focus-visible,.ds-family-screen select:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--primary,#e0c48b);outline-offset:3px}.ds-family .ds-tile{width:64px;height:64px;padding:0;background:var(--rarity-5,#936131)}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-family{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

narrative.overview:
Ilimmu uses a quiet dark workspace with warm gold actions and sourced game art.
Compact editing rows keep equipment and progression readable. Artwork identifies
characters beside editable data.

This refresh records the implemented Characters surface and existing shell.
Frontmatter describes runtime values from `src/app.css` and Characters
components. The earlier intended system below remains future direction where
it differs; this redesign does not apply a global palette or font migration.
keyCharacteristics: Dark navy surfaces with restrained gold actions.
Portrait navigation and compact equipment editing.
Actual progression remains separate from named targets.
dos: **Do** use portraits and names as links to character profiles.
**Do** keep actual progression and progression targets separate.
**Do** preserve labeled main-stat rows on narrow screens.
**Do** retain the existing shell outside the scoped Characters redesign.
donts: **Don't** restore manual character creation or a portrait-grid roster.
**Don't** add role, substat, or weight fields to this build surface.
**Don't** describe two-piece effect selection as saved artifact inventory.
